findings.message: The eight filter params (listaId, responsavelId, prioridade, status, prazoDe, prazoAte, venceHoje, atrasada) have effect filter:tarefasEquipe but no state holds them. Added one public persisted state per param, and listarTarefasEquipe(filters, page, append) takes a TarefasEquipeFilterChange that publishes them and reloads from the first page.

reatribuirTarefa needs the member the person chooses, but no state has reatribuirTarefa.input as its source. Added the reatribuirTarefaDraft state (ReatribuirTarefaDraft) and its setter setReatribuirTarefaDraft; id and version come from the selected tarefa.

reatribuirTarefa and cancelarTarefa return a TarefaDetalhe, but the board rows (TarefaEquipeItem) have extra fields (lista, details.venceHoje, details.atrasada, details.progressoChecklist) that the output does not carry. The shared patches only the shared fields of the row (title, responsible, priority, due date, status) and removes the row when it no longer matches the active filters; the row indicators stay stale until the list is reloaded.
The returned tarefa (output of both commands) has no state whose source is the command output; it is applied to the state tarefa (obterTarefa.tarefa) and to the matching row of tarefas.
